name: Abhishek Veeramalla
role: CTO at AKVA, Content Creator & Educator, Former RedHat Principal Engineer
bio: Abhishek Veeramalla is the CTO at AKVA and a former Principal Engineer at Red Hat. He runs a widely followed YouTube channel focused on DevOps, AI, and cloud computing, and his educational courses on platforms like Udemy have helped over 1,000 students launch their careers.

name: Hitesh Choudhary
role: Tech video creator, Co-Founder at Learnyst
bio: Hitesh Choudhary is passionate about education. He serves around 22 million users via Learnyst and teaches cutting-edge technology to over 2 million subscribers on YouTube. Previously, Hitesh served as a CTO and most recently as a Senior Director at PW. Currently, he is fully dedicated to his passion for teaching and building content for the developer community on YouTube.

name: Laurent Gil
role: Cloud Expert, Forbes Council, Finops Foundation Governing Board Member, Co-founder at Cast AI
bio: Laurent is Co-founder and President at Cast Ai, leading product and business development. Previously, he co-founded Zenedge (acquired by Oracle in 2018) and Viewdle (acquired by Google in 2012). He is also a FinOps Governing Board Member, recognized cloud expert, and Forbes Council member.

name: Kunal Kushwaha
role: Senior Developer Advocate at Cast AI
bio: Kunal Kushwaha, Founder of WeMakeDevs and Senior Developer Advocate at Cast Ai, runs one of the fastest-growing educational coding channels on YouTube with over 800,000 subscribers. He produces podcasts, hosts community events, and creates engaging content on coding, tools, and various developer topics.

name: Ravi Shankar
role: DevOps Expert | Udemy Instructor | YouTuber
bio: Ravi Shankar has 15 years of experience in IT and DevOps and specializes in building scalable cloud and automation solutions across AWS and Azure. He is also a Udemy instructor and YouTuber, sharing DevOps knowledge with a community of over 100,000 learners. Ravi is passionate about simplifying complex technologies and helping professionals grow in their careers.

name: Chandika S
role: Cloud & DevOps Architect at Autodesk
bio: Chandika is a seasoned DevOps and cloud engineering professional with over 10 years of experience in Linux systems, multi-cloud platforms, DevOps, containerization, and automation. She has worked across diverse environments, helping teams build reliable, scalable, and efficient platforms. She enjoys mentoring peers, contributing to discussions, and creating learning content that supports the broader tech community. Outside of her core work, Chandika is enthusiastic about staying current with evolving technologies and sharing practical, real-world insights through social media platforms.

name: Ranjini Ganeshan
role: Senior Cloud Engineer (AWS) | DevOps & Kubernetes Practitioner
bio: Ranjini Ganeshan is a Staff DevOps Engineer at Trellix with over 15 years of experience in cloud, SRE, and automation. She specializes in Kubernetes, observability, and cost optimization on AWS. Ranjini actively contributes to the tech community by speaking at meetups and writing on Medium. She is passionate about building resilient, scalable systems and helping teams innovate faster. Outside of work, she enjoys terrace gardening and spending time with her two boys.

name: Ram Iyengar
role: Chief Evangelist at Cloud Foundry Foundation
bio: Ram Iyengar is the Chief Evangelist at Cloud Foundry Foundation, driving community engagement and platform advocacy.

name: Ajeet Singh Raina
role: Technology Influencer | 🐳 Developer Advocate at Docker | Author at Collabnix.com | Distinguished Arm Ambassador
bio: Ajeet Singh Raina is a Technology Influencer, Developer Advocate at Docker, and the author of Collabnix.com. He is also a Distinguished Arm Ambassador, sharing insights on containerization, cloud-native technologies, and DevOps practices.

name: Aparna Prabhu
role: Senior Engineering Manager at Digital Ocean
bio: Aparna leads the storage and platform teams at DigitalOcean, where she and her teams build dependable, easy-to-use cloud infrastructure. She enjoys applying AI thoughtfully to improve how teams build and operate cloud systems. Most importantly, she always focuses on getting the fundamentals right - performance, efficiency, scale, and automation.

name: Rahul Jadhav
role: Co-founder and CTO at AccuKnox
bio: Rahul Jadhav is the Co-Founder and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) of AccuKnox, a Bengaluru-based company specializing in Zero-Trust Kubernetes runtime security.

name: Shubham Londhe
role: Senior Developer Advocate at Temporal Technologies.
bio: This is Shubham Londhe, a Developer Advocate and an Educator, passionate about developing and deploying production-ready applications while building and working with teams of Software Developers, aspiring to become a Technical Architect.

name: Shashank Karpal
role: Director of Business Growth at KodeKloud
bio:
Shashank Karpal is Director of Education & Government Programs at KodeKloud, the hands-on platform for AI-native DevOps and Cloud used by 1.3M+ learners. He partners with CIOs, platform, and L&D leaders across IMEA, APAC, and CIS to launch zero-setup AI labs, agents and RAG practice, and job-simulated projects, and he measures adoption and productivity impact with analytics. 
At KodeKloud he steers AI playgrounds and agentic workflows such as MCP and LangChain, a multilingual AI tutor, and outcome dashboards aligned to certifications and roles. A regular at leading AI, cloud, and developer conferences, he shares practical, non-commercial playbooks that favor real labs over slides for safe, rapid adoption at scale.

name: Kaushik Deb
role: Associate Director, AI Engineering at Piramal Finance
bio: Kaushik Deb is an accomplished Associate Director of AI Engineering with over 12 years of experience delivering advanced technological solutions. His professional focus centers on Generative AI and Agentic Systems within the Financial Services domain.Kaushik specializes in architecting strategic, enterprise - grade AI platforms designed to address complex business challenges and drive substantial operational efficiency. Throughout his career, he has successfully led the development and scaling of award-winning Gen AI products. A key pillar of Kaushik's work involves driving technological maturity. He has modernized various AI platform architectures, elevating them to an advanced level to ensure the reliability and scalability of dozens of mission-critical AI and Machine Learning models. As a leader, Kaushik manages large engineering teams and oversees the entire product lifecycle - from strategic vision and budget management to final execution - to deliver innovative, high-ROI AI solutions across the organization.

name: Sushant Gulati
role: Senior Engineer Manager at BigBasket
bio: Sushant Gulati is a technology leader at BigBasket with experience in scalable systems and cloud infrastructure.

name: Pramod Singh
role: Expert Associate Partner, Data Science at Bain & Company
bio: Pramod Singh is a Senior Consultant at Bain & Company with expertise in business strategy and digital transformation.

name: Shuva Jyoti Kar
role: Principal Engineer at Palo Alto Networks
bio: Shuva is a Principal Engineer at Palo Alto Networks. Previously, as a Senior Technical Leader at Cisco Systems, he led the Data Platform for AI-driven Network Analytics. A serverless enthusiast and active open-source contributor, Shuva has a strong background as an open-source committer. He is a frequent speaker at industry-leading events, including Open Source Summits, KubeCon, and GDG DevFests, sharing insights on building critical data processing components for the cloud-native era.
description: With over a decade of experience in real-time network analytics at enterprise scale, Shuva joins the stage as a Principal Engineer at Palo Alto Networks—where his new mission is baking security directly into serverless AI.

name: Shruti Mantri
role: Staff Engineer at Google
bio: Shruti Mantri is an Architect at Google with expertise in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems design.

name: Naresh Waswani
role: Senior Architect at Simpplr Inc.
bio:
I’m a hands-on architect with deep expertise in building resilient, distributed systems and modernizing enterprise platforms using Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Over the years, I’ve helped organizations scale with confidence—navigating the trade-offs of asynchronous design while embedding reliability, auditability, and observability from day one.
I’m the AWS User Group Nagpur Leader, where I actively drive local cloud and developer communities through technical sessions, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and mentorship. I’ve also been a proud AWS Community Builder for over 6 years, regularly contributing through blogging, public speaking, and helping engineering teams adopt cloud-native best practices. I hold multiple professional certifications in AWS and Kubernetes and remain deeply invested in building platforms that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and easy to operate.
My recent work focuses on Generative AI, Agentic AI, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). I design multi-agent systems that bring domain-specific intelligence to SaaS platforms- enabling conversational insights, contextual workflows, and AI-driven automation across microservices. This work blends platform engineering with AI orchestration, ensuring systems remain tenant-aware, secure, and performant at scale.
From cloud infrastructure and migrations to AI-driven governance and observability, I drive architectural consistency across complex ecosystems. My core focus is enabling teams through platform engineering, resilience practices, and a chaos-as-a-mindset approach - turning both fault testing and AI experimentation into everyday engineering habits.
In 2025, I delivered technical talks at AWS Community Days in Pune and Bangalore, sharing real-world lessons on cloud-native architecture and system resilience.

name: Abhishek Choudhary
role: Founder at TrueFoundry
bio:
Abhishek Choudhary, IIT Kharagpur CS grad, is co-founder & CTO of TrueFoundry, an AI+MCP Gateway used by F500 enterprises. Former Senior Staff Engineer at Meta leading the Videos org where he was one of the fastest growing engineers. Recognized speaker at top AI conferences including Agentic AI Summit, CIVO Navigate, GenAI Summit, DataHack Summit & Cypher.

Through his speaking engagements spanning from San Francisco's technical meetups to India's premier AI summits, combined with his hands-on experience scaling systems for billions of users at Meta and entrepreneurial success with TrueFoundry, Abhishek has established himself as one of the most influential voices bridging cutting-edge research with practical enterprise AI implementation.

name: Jose Jayanandaraj
role: Senior Expert at Bosch Global Software Technologies
bio: Jose Jayanandaraj is a seasoned technology professional currently working as a Senior Expert at Bosch Global Software Technologies (BGSW) in Tamil Nadu, India.

name: Hima Bindu
role: Associate Director, Strategy and Transformation at EY
bio: Hima Bindu is a Technology Transformation and Strategy Leader , where she helps global enterprises redesign and modernize their Managed Services operating models for the cloud-native and AI era. With over 20+ years of experience across Application Management, Cloud Operations, and AI-enabled service delivery

name: Arpit Tripathi
role: Technical Director at TelcoLearn
bio: Arpit is a researcher in security and optimization for 5G and beyond networks, with a focus on private 5G and edge deployments for future enterprise use. His research primarily focuses on security for cloud, virtualization and software-defined networks. He holds a Graduate Certificate in Tech Policy from The Takshashila Institution, reflecting his interest in telecom standards and technology policy. He additionally is the CRISP fellow at BITS Law School working on India's SEP governance framework to incentivize research for telecommunication in India.

name: Utkarsh Tripathi
role: Principal Data Scientist at Micron Technology
bio:
Utkarsh Tripathi is a Principal Data Scientist at Micron Technology specializing in transforming complex data into strategic business assets. With over 11 years of experience and an MS in AI & ML, his work is at the forefront of applied artificial intelligence and business transformation.
A respected voice in the AI community, Utkarsh recently presented his work on agentic AI with Snowflake Cortex at the Snowflake World Tour in Hyderabad. His research paper on Text2SQL was published in the Lattice journal and presented at the MLDS 2025 conference. This passion for innovation is also showcased by his recent achievements, including securing a top 1% placement at Google's Agentic AI Day and leading his team to victory in a Snowflake-sponsored hackathon - Dev Premier League.

name: Atulpriya Sharma
role: Senior Developer Advocate at Improving
bio:
Atul is a Senior Developer Advocate at Improving and a CNCF Ambassador dedicated to helping organizations and individuals navigate the cloud native landscape. With a decade of experience across the software lifecycle, he specializes in platform engineering, developer relations, and fostering vibrant technical communities.

As a frequent speaker and community leader, Atul has shared insights at premier global stages including KubeCons and CloudNative Rejekts, as well as various Kubernetes Community Days (KCDs). He also serves as a key organizer for the Cloud Native Hyderabad community, and was the Co-Chair for KubeCon India in 2025.

A seasoned content strategist, Atul blends his technical roots in Computer Science with a marketing background to produce impactful resources. His work is regularly featured on platforms like TheNewStack, reflecting a deep-seated passion for making complex technologies accessible through storytelling and community-driven advocacy.

name: Rohit Ghumare
role: Head of Developer Relations at Motia
bio: Rohit Ghumare is Head of Developer Relations at Motia and Founder of DevRelAsService, specializing in AI, DevOps, and cloud-native technologies. As CNCF 2025 Marketing Committee Co-Chair, Google Developer Expert (Cloud & AI), CNCF Ambassador, Docker Captain, and AWS Community Builder, he leads global developer communities with a focus on platform engineering and AI infrastructure. Rohit has delivered 50+ presentations at international conferences, contributed to major open-source projects including Istio's journey to CNCF graduation, and built developer programs reaching 10,000+ members. Previously, he led Developer Advocacy at Cerbos and solo.io, and served as Principal Product Evangelist at Taikun. His expertise spans Kubernetes, service mesh, MLOps, GenAI, and AI agents. Passionate about empowering developers through technical content and community building, Rohit bridges the gap between cutting-edge technology and practical implementation for modern cloud-native and AI workloads.

name: Suman Chakraborty
role: Solution Architect at Platform9 Systems
bio: Suman Chakraborty is a Solutions Architect at Platform9 systems. He is a consultant and advisor for Kubernetes & Cloud Native Solutions, helping Customers and End users in their application modernisation journey and adoption with DevOps best practices. Suman has been a distinguished speaker and had delivered sessions on Devops, Cloud-Native tools, Kubernetes & Serverless technology at KubeCon India, Open Source Summit, Hashitalks (HashiCorp), AWS Community Days, Google Cloud Community Days.

name: Arsh Goyal
role: Engineering and AI Creator at ThoughtSpot
bio: Arsh Goyal is a Senior Software Engineer at ThoughtSpot specializing in cloud technologies and distributed systems.

name: Shubham Rai
role: Engineering at Truefoundry
bio: Shubham Rai is a Staff Software Engineer at TrueFoundry focused on Kubernetes and distributed systems. A KubeElasti contributor, he spends his time debugging autoscalers, improving reliability at scale, and making cloud costs predictable for operators.

name: Savinder Puri
role: Associate VP at Zenser Technologies
bio:
With over 24 years of experience, Savinder Puri partners with global CIOs and CTOs to design and scale DevOps, SRE, and AI-driven software delivery.

A global speaker and author, Savinder translates complex technology into strategic insights while fostering an engaged professional community through his YouTube channel. He brings a unique perspective to the industry by integrating technical excellence with spiritual growth, guiding organizations toward resilience and purpose alongside digital transformation.

name: Yogesh Trivedi
role: Founder & CEO at CognitivTrust
bio: Yogesh Trivedi is the Founder & CEO of CognitivTrust, where he's building the security and governance layer for the agentic development era. He brings 15+ years of enterprise security experience from Google Cloud, Meta, the Federal Reserve, and GE Digital. He founded CognitivTrust to solve what he believes is the defining infrastructure problem of the AI coding era: autonomous development systems that are secure by default, not as an afterthought. Yogesh holds an MS in Management of Technology from NYU.

name: Yash Shah
role: AI Solution Engineer at CognitivTrust
bio: Yash Shah is an AI Solution Engineer at CognitivTrust building the security context layer for agentic systems. Works across LLM-powered agents, multi-agent architectures, and RAG pipelines. Focused on enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI systems with built-in trust, governance, and real-time security context.

name: Matas Kaminskas
role: Engineering Manager at Cast AI
bio: Matas Kaminskas is an Engineering Manager at Cast AI, where he leads the Autoscaler team - the engine behind node provisioning, spot instance management, and GPU optimization across customer clusters. His team shipped the industry's first Dynamic Resource Allocation support for GPU sharing, enabling workloads to share a single GPU and cutting costs by up to 75%. Outside of work, he's usually bouldering or reading about what makes engineering teams tick.

name: Narunas Kapocius
role: Senior Engineering Manager at Cast AI
bio: Narunas Kapocius is a Senior Engineering Manager at Cast AI, with a background in SRE and DevOps. He got into Kubernetes during his ICT studies, benchmarking CNI plugin performance across throughput, latency, and resource usage — and has been working with cloud-native infrastructure ever since. At Cast AI, he leads the Identity and Billing teams focused on enterprise experience and helping customers get the most out of the platform. Outside of work, he follows Formula 1 closely, where hundreds of engineers push reliability and performance to their absolute limits.

name: Shiv Pratap Singh
role: Co-founder and CTO at Nudgebee
bio: Shiv Pratap Singh is the Co-founder and CTO of Nudgebee, an agentic AI platform for SRE and cloud ops teams. With 13+ years of experience scaling infrastructure for startups and enterprises, Shiv leads product and engineering at Nudgebee, building context-aware AI agents that investigate production incidents and optimize cloud operations across multi-cloud environments.

name: Shivay Lamba
role: CNCF Ambassador
bio: Shivay Lamba is a software engineer and open source contributor passionate about AI and edge computing. With experience across startups and enterprise tech, he focuses on simplifying complex technologies for developers. Shivay actively speaks at global conferences, organizes community events, and contributes to projects in cloud-native ecosystems, WebAssembly, and machine learning. He has also built and mentored educational programs to bridge gaps in emerging tech adoption. When not coding, he enjoys writing, traveling, and mentoring young technologists.

name: Zilvinas Urbonas
role: Senior Director of Engineering at Cast AI
bio: Engineer with more than 10 years of full-stack experience in cloud & AI native systems, with a focus on cloud infrastructure automation and cost optimization.

name: Krish Srivastava
role: SDE - I Platform at PhysicsWallah
bio: Krish Srivastava is an SDE on the Platform team at PhysicsWallah. He built DevAstra-AI, a tool-driven system that queries live infrastructure (Kubernetes, Elasticsearch/APM, Jenkins) and correlates the results to produce structured root-cause hypotheses in under 30 seconds.
